integrity_notes: Complete self-contained infinite-family topological proof; finite mod-two checks are supplemental and do not establish the general claim.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies to finite nonempty P4-free graphs and the component-size-two independence complex; it does not treat higher bounds, canonical generators, shellability or equivariant homology. No exhaustive global novelty guarantee is asserted.
title: Cotree homotopy classification of two-independence complexes of cographs
